name: adriteyo-portfolio
buildCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/hugo-bin && curl -fsSL https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.166.0/hugo_extended_0.166.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/hugo.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/hugo.tar.gz -C /tmp/hugo-bin && curl -fsSL https://github.com/sass/dart-sass/releases/download/1.105.0/dart-sass-1.105.0-linux-x64.tar.gz -o /tmp/dart-sass.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/dart-sass.tar.gz -C /tmp/hugo-bin && ln -sf /tmp/hugo-bin/dart-sass/sass /tmp/hugo-bin/sass && PATH="/tmp/hugo-bin:$PATH" hugo --gc --minify --baseURL "https://adriteyo-das.vercel.app/"
